svg.title: VM layout: 2 HAProxy VMs with VIP directing traffic to 3 PostgreSQL VMs managed by Patroni
svg.desc: Two HAProxy VMs share a Virtual IP. Traffic is load-balanced to three PostgreSQL VMs each running Patroni for HA cluster management.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do clients connect to HAProxy via the virtual IP?')
sendPrompt('How does a virtual IP work with HAProxy for failover?')
sendPrompt('What does an HAProxy VM do in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('How does HAProxy failover with keepalived and VIP?')
sendPrompt('What role does Patroni play on a PostgreSQL primary node?')
sendPrompt('How does Patroni manage a replica node in a cluster?')
sendPrompt('Can HAProxy do health checks on Patroni REST API?')
